_comment: Content subsets -> video-code prefixes, used to scope search via the DB video_filter (video_name prefix match). EDIT freely; reloaded on save. 'label' shows in the UI, 'default' = checkbox checked on load. Prefix 'N' matches all N001-N100; 'L26' matches L26_V*. A prefix is matched against every WORD of the file name (L26 / V001 / mp4), so never use a bare 'M' (it matches 'mp4', i.e. every video) or 'V'.
